snippet.title: ShatterswarmTrailer
snippet.description:
🚀 WISHLIST SHATTERSWARM ON STEAM NOW! 🚀
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421190/Shatterswarm/

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shatterswarm is an epic space video game launching February 3, 2027! Command your fleet, build defensive networks, and defend Earth's last survivors against the relentless Voxan Empire in this strategic space video game.

🎮 GAMEPLAY FEATURES:
• Fleet Command & Strategic Combat
• Base Building & Colony Management
• Tower Defense Mechanics
• Epic Multi-Phase Boss Battles
• Resource Management
• Direct Ship Combat

Face off against commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex as you fight for humanity's survival in this premium short game.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📅 RELEASE DATE: February 3, 2027
🎮 PLATFORM: Steam
🏷️ GENRE: Strategy, Space, Base Building, Tower Defense

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 ABOUT SHATTERSWARM:

Shatterswarm combines the best elements of fleet command, base building, and tower defense into one immersive space video game experience. Build earth's last survivors a new home in a hostile star system where every decision matters. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy!

This premium short game from Iron Fin Games delivers the perfect blend of tactical decision-making and action-packed combat, all set in a beautifully crafted space environment.
